description: A chat with an AI model (client docs/plan-ia-chat.md § 2.2): its messages are the message collection's

model.description: the model it runs on: a name of hubby.json ai, or a model added by link

engine.description: what answers: local (a model on the device), else a device agent's id (claude-code, gemini-cli, codex…)

summary.description: what its oldest messages said, once they no longer fit the model's context (phase 2)

summaryUpTo.description: the last message the summary covers
